sentences.en: I only slept with you because you were blackmailing me.
sentences.zh: 我之所以和你发生关系，是因为你在勒索我。

sentences.en: Abusive people often use emotional blackmail to get what they want.
sentences.zh: 施虐的人常常使用情感勒索来达到自己的目的。

sentences.en: Yanni used his erratic behavior as a way to blackmail Skura.
sentences.zh: 亚尼利用自己不稳定的举止作为手段来敲诈斯库拉。

senses.zh: 勒索，敲诈；胁迫，威胁；勒索金
